property_summary: For any caller address X, only the current owner can successfully call transferOwnership to change owner; the mutant allowing non-owners breaks this by permitting non-owners to change owner (so owner after a transfer differs).
change_summary: Change the require in onlyOwner from require(msg.sender == owner); to require(msg.sender != owner); reversing the guard so only non-owners can call transferOwnership, which changes who can update owner and thus can change the final owner value.
